cues: Lu Xun is the pen name of Zhou Shuren, the founder of modern Chinese literature.
Born in eighteen eighty one into a once wealthy family, he spent his boyhood between pawnshops and pharmacies after its collapse.
He went to Japan to study medicine, then gave it up, deciding that his people needed healthy minds more than healthy bodies, and that literature could help.
His story A Madman's Diary was the first modern story written in everyday spoken Chinese.
